li.label: marked by the Warscar
li.description: Something followed me out of the Warscar. It doesn't say anything. It doesn't have to.

li.label: marked by the Warscar
li.description: The mark is getting heavier. I dream about the place even when I'm nowhere near it.

li.label: marked by the Warscar
li.description: I can't tell anymore where the Warscar ends and I begin.
